root_cause: vLLM rejected startup before weight loading because the 29.38 GiB free snapshot was below the 29.69 GiB budget requested by gpu-memory-utilization=0.98.
interpretation: This is not a model-fit result and contains no performance measurement. The observed free capacity is sufficient to pass the same startup guard at 0.96 (29.09 GiB), which R20 tests without changing the workload.
correction: R20 changes only gpu-memory-utilization from 0.98 to 0.96 and uses a fresh server/cache/run directory.
